html:
EMPEROR CRUISES

Inspired by the luxurious life of Emperor Bao Dai, Vietnam’s last emperor, Emperor Cruises offers guests a unique and indulgent experience. Enjoy the perfect blend of music, fine arts, architecture, culture, local cuisine, history, and outdoor activities, all included to ensure you are treated like royalty.

Our fleet offers two signature itineraries:

  • Nha Trang Discovery Day Cruise

  • Sunset Cocktail & Dinner Cruise

We guarantee daily departures, regardless of passenger numbers. If luxury is your language, we speak the same language.

HOW TO GET THERE

A scenic 40 minute drive from Cam Ranh International Airport brings you to the heart of Nha Trang City. From the city center, it’s approximately 15 minutes to the port where you will board Emperor Cruises.

Based in Nha Trang Bay, the cruise offers breathtaking white-sand beaches and pristine offshore islands, perfect for exploration and leisure.

DETAILED ITINERARY

07:30 – 08:00
Pick-up from your hotel and transfer to Vinh Truong Island Waterway Port to board Emperor Cruises. Guests will be transferred from the port to the main boat via a tender or smaller boat.

08:30
Arrive on board and enjoy a welcome drink. Your Experiences Manager will introduce you to Nha Trang Bay, local culture, cuisine, history, the emperor’s legacy, and safety precautions. Begin cruising through the stunning Nha Trang Bay.

08:45 – 09:15
Cruise past Tam and Mot islands while listening to classical music performed by a live guitarist. Enjoy drinks and fresh fruits as you approach the fish farm.

09:15 – 10:00
Explore the fish farm and its surroundings on a traditional basket boat. Admire the scenic landscapes around the floating village.

10:00 – 12:00
Arrive at Sỏi Beach. Guests can swim, kayak, or snorkel (weather permitting). Alternatively, relax under the trees and enjoy the panoramic views of the bay. Optional activities such as diving, jet skiing, parasailing, and banana boat rides are available at an additional cost.

12:00 – 13:30
Return to the boat for a sumptuous lunch on board, including local beers, soft drinks, fine wine, or premium spirits. The boat anchors near Hon Tre Island in its tranquil lagoon. After lunch, relax and enjoy the boat’s facilities.

14:00
Cruise back to Vinh Truong Island Waterway Port, passing Vung Ngan Floating Village and Vinpearl Island. Guests are transferred by tender to the port, where the shuttle bus will take you back to your hotel.

Note: Itinerary and timings may vary by ±30 minutes depending on weather and sea conditions. Final pick-up time will be confirmed one day before the cruise.

PRICE

Price per person (pax): USD 48

BENEFITS INCLUDED

  • Hotel pick-up and drop-off in central Nha Trang

  • Welcome drink on board

  • Experiences Manager on board (English, Russian, Korean, Vietnamese)

  • Snorkeling kit, basket boat, kayaking, fishing

  • Sumptuous lunch on board

  • Free Wi-Fi

  • Unlimited drinks: house wine, cocktails, spirits, local beer, soft drinks, fruit juice, tea, coffee, mineral water

  • Seasonal fruits

  • All sightseeing tickets

  • Bath towels and tissues

EXCLUSIONS (Optional Activities)

  • Diving: VND 750,000/person

  • Sea Walking: VND 1,050,000/person

  • Jet Ski: VND 800,000/person

  • Parasailing: VND 800,000/person

  • Banana Boat: VND 1,500,000/boat (for 5 people)

  • Personal expenses and other fees not mentioned above

WHAT TO BRING

  • Camera or video recorder

  • Swimsuit for sunny days

  • Comfortable shoes (for trekking) and sweater (for cooler days)

  • Hat or cap

  • Suntan lotion

  • Extra t-shirt in case you get wet
